'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 John Veasey LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' John Veese
* '''Deck name:''' Against my best tests
* '''Username:''' Veez
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
